units.poolKey: COMBINATION C4: a low rung on a working approach
units.spine: The road in gives no trouble, though the place at the end of it is poor.

units.poolKey: INCOME MIX: one source carries the town
units.spine: Every living in this place is paid out of one trade.

units.poolKey: TRADE PROFILE: exports and imports both present
units.spine: What goes out of this place is made in it, while what comes in is what nobody here can make.
The trade out of Warmholz rests on several goods rather than one.
Nobody here goes hungry, and the margin that keeps it so is thin.
The salt this place works is bought in, not raised.
